citation: Farkas, L. G., et al. (1985). Anthropometric facial proportions in healthy North American Caucasians. Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery.
disclaimer: Reference bands reflect classical anatomical proportions and morphological variations in anthropometric literature. They describe photographic geometry, not personal worth or health status.

vertical_thirds_upper.name: Upper Third (Forehead)
vertical_thirds_upper.description: Proportion of facial height from hairline (trichion) to brow (glabella).

vertical_thirds_middle.name: Middle Third (Midface)
vertical_thirds_middle.description: Proportion of facial height from brow (glabella) to nose base (subnasale).

vertical_thirds_lower.name: Lower Third (Lower Face)
vertical_thirds_lower.description: Proportion of facial height from nose base (subnasale) to chin (menton).

horizontal_fifths_intercanthal.name: Intercanthal Width (Fifth)
horizontal_fifths_intercanthal.description: Distance between inner eye corners as a proportion of total bizygomatic face width.

facial_index.name: Facial Index (Morphology)
facial_index.description: Ratio of total facial height to bizygomatic width (Nasion-Menton / Zygion-Zygion * 100).

nasal_index.name: Nasal Index
nasal_index.description: Ratio of nasal width to nasal height (Alare-Alare / Nasion-Subnasale * 100).

mouth_to_interpupillary_ratio.name: Mouth to Interpupillary Ratio
mouth_to_interpupillary_ratio.description: Ratio of cheilion distance to interpupillary distance.

facial_symmetry_index.name: Facial Symmetry Index
facial_symmetry_index.description: Bilateral balance score across paired landmarks relative to mid-sagittal plane.

jaw_angle.name: Gonial Jaw Angle
jaw_angle.description: Angle between mandibular ramus and mandibular body.
